meta.title: CGL Football
meta.notes: A slice of an early-80s network broadcast. Our CGL FOOTBALL bumper over the Lyria brass theme, the stadium wide and Chet's welcome, the KEYS TO THE GAME card (cut on "keys") filling in line by line as Moose starts each key, a 1.0 s beat before his afterthought on key three, then a pass and a run under Chet's calls with our 4TH score strip, the fullback going down and staying down, the final gun under our FINAL 24-21 box, Chet's question, a silent booth shot for the 1.65 s pause, Moose's callback over the box, and the bumper again with the theme's opening fanfare as the sting. Chet is ElevenLabs Eric and Moose is Roger; every line is its own TTS file at 1.3, placed off the previous line's speech length, so every gap is set in the edit (Chet's pass call is three files, each on its action). The ElevenLabs crowd bed runs from just before the stadium shot, three passes of its 20 s file crossfaded, dipped about 3 dB under each Moose line and further through the pause and his last answer; the shots keep their own sound low. Ported from football/edit.mjs. Not expressible yet, written as the closest equivalent: the bumper and the card are stills (here PNG segments held from in 0, silent); the early-80s tape look over the whole finished picture (scaled down to 600x338 and back, chroma shifted, saturation, contrast, gamma and colour balance pulled, live grain) is a picture filter, so it is left out and the overlays are drawn clean; the crowd bed is one sound made of three crossfaded passes with one volume curve over all of it (here three clips with linear fades for the crossfades, each carrying the dips that fall inside it); the closing bumper's layers are enabled until 2.2 s after the outro starts, past the end of the cut (here until @end); and the limiter on the whole mix (alimiter, limit 0.95).

segments.label: Our CGL FOOTBALL bumper: stripes sweep in, CGL drops, FOOTBALL slides on
High wide of the packed stadium: Chet's welcome
KEYS TO THE GAME card, cut on "keys"
Line of scrimmage: the snap and the throw
Tighter: the receiver catches it in stride
The big fullback up the middle, wrapped up and down face first
Final gun: Icebreakers celebrating, Tarpons walking off, under the FINAL box
The booth, silent: Moose thinks, Chet waits
Back to the FINAL box for Moose's answer

lines.speaker: Chet
lines.text: Good afternoon, everybody, and welcome to CGL Football.

lines.speaker: Chet
lines.text: Moose, what are your keys to the game?

lines.speaker: Moose
lines.text: Key number one: score more points than the other team.

lines.speaker: Moose
lines.text: Key number two: don't let the other team score more points than you.

lines.speaker: Moose
lines.text: Key number three: don't tackle your own guys.

lines.speaker: Moose
lines.text: I've seen it, Chet. It doesn't help.

lines.speaker: Chet
lines.text: Haugen, up the middle... and he is brought down.

lines.speaker: Moose
lines.text: That's a big man. When a big man falls down, Chet, he's down.

lines.speaker: Chet
lines.text: Moose, the Icebreakers win it. What was the difference today?

lines.speaker: Moose
lines.text: Chet... nobody tackled their own guys.

music.label: Theme: full under the bumper, low under the welcome, gone by Chet's question

Crowd bed, third pass: back up after Moose's answer, out under the bumper
